extension.summary: 雾汐｜轻量透明皮肤，可选搭配 Emby for Kodi NextGen 与 Mistuary Helper，支持多评分展示
Mistuary - Lightweight transparent skin, optionally pairs with Emby for Kodi NextGen and Mistuary Helper, with multi-rating support
extension.description: 基于 Estuary N 改造，画面优先。原生适配 Emby for Kodi NextGen 动态节点；安装可选插件 Mistuary Helper 后，详情页可显示豆瓣评分，并与 IMDb、TMDB、烂番茄评分并存（同时最多两个）。保留透黑/透白双主题，页面、浮窗、播放透明度可调。

Estuary N based video-first skin. Natively compatible with Emby for Kodi NextGen dynamic nodes. With the optional Mistuary Helper add-on, the video info dialog shows Douban ratings alongside IMDb, TMDB and Rotten Tomatoes (up to two at a time). Features dark & light transparent themes with adjustable transparency for pages, popups and playback overlay.
extension.disclaimer: Weather, radio and game browsing surfaces are intentionally omitted.
本皮肤有意省略天气、电台和游戏浏览界面。
